title: Telegram bots
help: Connect your own bot, change its settings and pair an administrator from this panel.
created: Bot settings saved. Verification runs when its schedule is enabled.
saved: Settings saved. Older in-flight results cannot replace this revision.
label: Bot label
replaceToken: Replacement token (leave empty to keep current)
tokenHelp: The token is encrypted and never returned. Use a replacement token for the same Telegram bot; connect a different bot as a separate record.
runtimeHelp: The normal Telegram API uses HTTPS. A local API server may use literal loopback HTTP. HTTP timeout must exceed polling timeout by at least five seconds.
pairHelp: Keep this one-use link private. Open it in Telegram and press Start, then refresh this page. Creating another link invalidates the previous link.
saveHelp: Saving uses the loaded revision. Status refresh preserves your draft. Reload settings explicitly to discard the draft and load concurrent changes. An active poll can finish before new settings take effect.
scope: Shop settings below connect this bot to shared products, wallets, manual payment review and service delivery. Live Telegram acceptance and independent offline operation remain pending.

fields.failure_retry_seconds: Minimum retry delay after a failure (seconds)

errors.invalid_token: Telegram rejected the token. Check or replace it.
errors.telegram_conflict: Telegram reports a conflicting webhook or another poller.
errors.response_limit: Telegram response exceeds the configured limit.
errors.webhook_configured: An existing webhook prevents polling. It has been preserved; remove it yourself before using this polling connection.
errors.bot_identity_changed: The replacement token belongs to a different bot. Connect it separately.
errors.bot_already_connected: That Telegram identity is already connected.
errors.access_revoked: The operator no longer has access.
